channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: Björk teases big announcement for 12 August
item.description: Fans believe that Björk's new record, a live appearance, or at least something will be happening on 12 August after the Icelandic songwriter and producer dropped the date into an Instagram post yesterday.

item.title: Avalon Emerson is embracing her season of change
item.description: The power of collaboration and necessity of shared human experience helped the California-born songwriter, producer and DJ Avalon Emerson find her next creative pivot.

item.title: Harry Styles compresses big feelings into futile songs on Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally.
item.description: Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally. is a collection of futile, brooding songs that finds Harry Styles trying to encapsulate bigger-than-life emotions but winding up too afraid to truly delve into them.

item.title: Clark Rainbow is building a pop empire from her childhood bedroom
item.description: The hyper-online producer and singer-songwriter Clark Rainbow opens up about her darkest fears and why her music is her most precious possession.

item.title: “You feel this music on your body”: Shye Ben Tzur and Jonny Greenwood return with new album Ranjha
item.description: Radiohead's Jonny Greenwood, Israeli composer Shye Ben Tzur, and Jonny Greenwood and Indian ensemble the Rajasthan Express have announced details of a new album, Ranjha, set for release on 8 May

item.title: Listen to Hayley Williams' Power Snatch cover This is Lorelei
item.description: Hayley Williams' new band Power Snatch has collaborated with Nate Amos, covering "Perfect Hand" as part of the super deluxe edition of Box For Buddy, Box For Star by This is Lorelei.

item.title: “We can both lean into being neurotic”: Ex-Moaning man Sean Solomon details Jarvis Taveniere-produced solo album
item.description: LA-based singer, songwriter and animator Sean Solomon has announced his debut solo album, The World Is Not Good Enough, set for release this spring and produced by Jarvis Taveniere (Purple Mountains, Waxahatchee).

item.title: Francis of Delirium reveals new album Run, Run Pure Beauty, shares euphoric single “It's a Beautiful Life”
item.description: Francis of Delirium - aka Luxembourg-based musician Jana Bahrich – has detailed plans for her second album Run, Run Pure Beauty, due for a 29 May release.

item.title: Morgan Nagler balances optimism and melancholy on new single, "Hurt"
item.description: Los Angeles-based artist Morgan Nagler has released "Hurt", the final preview of her debut album, I've Got Nothing to Lose, and I'm Losing It.

item.title: Teen Suicide unveil new track, "Spiders"
item.description: Teen Suicide have shared "Spiders", the latest single from their upcoming album, Nude descending staircase headless.
